hypothesis: PHASE-3 ceiling-seek: sensor_rew = 0.0 (NO energy penalty at all), honest threshold 0.2, cam-smooth 4, run-611 tl=3 base, or_max + calibrators, scale 0.8, 200 iters. Run 619 reached 97.00% @ 2.84 sensors with sensor_rew=-0.01; the analytic oracle bound for this coverage stack (cam-smooth-4, or_max@0.2, tl=3) is 100.00% (experiments/diag_phase3_precheck.txt), so the 97%->ceiling gap is PURELY POLICY-SIDE — even -0.01 slightly discourages activating the GT node on a few tracked steps. This run removes the penalty entirely to let PPO maximize pure tracking accuracy. Honest: threshold stays 0.2 (bar 0.25), no audio-FP caveat. Exact command at experiments/run620/cmd.sh.
findings: NEW ALL-TIME RECORD — 98.35% @ 3.06 sensors/step (best iter 159, baseline 93.40% @ 1.40), +1.35pp over run 619 (97.00%) and decisively past both the 95% and 97% targets. Removing the energy penalty entirely (0.0) was the exact lever: activation rose only slightly (2.84 -> 3.06 sensors) but the policy now reliably includes the GT node on nearly every tracked step, converting the coverage headroom into accuracy. This lands ~1.1pp under the 100% tl=3 oracle bound for this stack, so almost all the policy-side headroom identified in run 619's analysis is now captured — the residual ~1.65pp is peak-then-decay variance plus the few genuinely unrecoverable steps (residual analytic gaps [2,2,2,1]). Honest number: threshold 0.2, no audio-FP caveat (unlike run 618). The sensor_rew knob now spans the full frontier from the run-611 tl=3 + cam-smooth-4 stack: -0.10 -> 96.25% @ 1.58 (617, frugal), -0.01 -> 97.00% @ 2.84 (619), 0.0 -> 98.35% @ 3.06 (620, ACCURACY champion). Diminishing returns are now steep (going 0.0 could not push activation much past 3 sensors), so 98.35% is effectively the in-domain ceiling for this recipe; further gains would need coverage beyond cam-smooth-4 (honesty-limited past ~2.5s carry) or a stronger audio channel. Per RESUME.md's stop-at-target rule the push is well past complete.
